message: Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && find build/host -name "*.c" | head -20 && echo "---total c---" && find build/host -name "*.c" | wc -l

message.content:
The `.c` files (mrblib.c, gem_init.c) don't have the `<@!` markers — they use the proper `MRB_SYM` macros. The `.pi` files have the markers because they were preprocessed with `MRB_PRESYM_SCANNING` defined. So I should build from the `.c` files (the generated ones) plus the original `.c` source, NOT the `.pi` files.

Let me build from the original source + generated C files with presym enabled (using the generated id.h/table.h).
